• Review inbound applications and resumes against role requirements, keeping the applicant queue current with no aged applications

• Conduct structured phone and video screening interviews using an approved screening guide and scorecard

• Write concise, evidence-based screen notes in ATS, working from meeting transcripts

• Make advance or decline decisions at the screening stage, and apply an accurate reason code to every candidate you disposition

• Flag strong candidates who may fit a different open role, and escalate patterns such as off-profile applicants or screening guides that don't reflect the role

• Support general upkeep of the ATS so job posts, application questions, candidate emails, and reporting stay accurate

🏆 What Success Looks Like

• Recruiters consistently agree with the candidates you advance. Quality matters more than volume.

• Every applicant is reviewed promptly, and every screen is documented the same day

• Candidates leave your screen with an accurate picture of the role and a professional impression of Luminize

• US-market recent recruiting experience

• Fluent professional English required, written and spoken with the ability to build rapport quickly

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent work experience

Luminize is a full-service Amazon growth partner helping brands succeed in a competitive digital marketplace. From creative strategy to advertising and analytics, we combine expertise and hustle to drive results for brands in CPG, health, wellness, beauty, and beyond.
Luminize also operates as Coastal Trading Ventures (CTV), our warehouse and fulfillment operation in Fort Worth, Texas. CTV keeps products moving from the dock to the customer, giving us end-to-end control of the brand experience from listing to delivery.
We are not your typical agency, and we like it that way. We operate with transparency, celebrate wins often, and treat every brand like it's our own.

jobs.description:

About SweetSpot Heating & Cooling
SweetSpot is a growing home-services company in the New York metro, and we are building our creative team from zero. This is the number one creative seat in the company, not a slot in a large agency hierarchy. The strategist hired here owns the function, works directly with the owner, and has a real path to leading the team as we scale.
About the role
We are hiring a creative strategist who will own paid ad creative end to end: research, angles, hooks, scripts, briefing creators and editors, and the learnings that turn winners into the next batch.
This is not a "make pretty ads" role and it is not strategy-only. You will direct really strong video editors and UGC creators, and you will use AI (including Claude Code) as your production engine for research, hooks, scripts and variants. We are honest about the level this role is hired at: we are looking for strong raw talent with real direct-response instincts who wants ownership and serious training, and who wants to grow into a top-tier strategist with us. You will get mentorship, a proven creative system, and weekly learnings reviews. In return we expect pace, curiosity, and work you can defend.
What you will do

• Build the research base first: homeowner avatars, desires, objections, competitors, and our own ad account history. No angles before research.

• Plan concepts in a structured roadmap, each with angle, avatar, desire, mechanism, authority, awareness level, emotion, positioning and urgency.

• Write hooks and scripts built for the first 3 seconds: one desire, one avatar, one message per ad.

• Brief UGC creators and editors so clearly they can execute with no follow-up call, and review their work to a finished, launch-ready ad.

• Run the testing system: from one winning angle, build structured iterations where each variation tests something named.

• Run the learnings: label every ad (Breakthrough, Spend Winner, KPI Winner, Loser), state why it performed, and turn that into the next round.

• Hit 20 to 30 finished, launch-ready ads per month at full pace, working with our editors and AI workflows.

What we are looking for

• Direct-response ad experience: you have written ads that ran as paid social (Meta or TikTok) and you can show them.

• A testing system, not just good taste. You can explain how you turn one winner into 20 variations.

• Research discipline. Your hooks trace to evidence, not guesses.

• AI fluency: you already use AI tools in your creative workflow and can show how.

• Execution: you have briefed creators or managed editors and shipped finished ads.

• Ownership mindset: you talk about business outcomes, not just outputs delivered, and you close feedback loops: you learn, you apply, you show what changed.

• Local services or lead generation experience is a plus, not a requirement. Seasonal urgency, emergency calls, proof and trust are the game here.

Pay and structure

• Contract (1099), remote, month-to-month: $4,000 to $8,000 per month, 40 hours per week, based on experience.

• Performance bonus structure discussed after the trial month, tied to winning ads.

• Growth path: this seat grows into leading the creative team. One of the paths we model is editor or strategist to team lead as spend scales.

Our hiring process (exactly how it works)

• Short application: portfolio of ads you wrote that actually ran, plus 3 short answers (your testing system on a real winner; one ad you iterated and what it tested; your AI workflow).

• Interview 1 (30 minutes): screening and craft in one call, run as a working session on your past ads: what did you learn, how did you apply it, what feedback loops did you complete.

• Paid test: $100 flat, 48 hours, capped at 4 hours of work, paid regardless of outcome. A short research snapshot, hooks, scripts, an iteration plan and an execution plan for a real scenario.

• Interview 2 (final, with the owner): we walk your test together and you defend your choices. References are checked after this call (we will ask to speak with one past employer). Two interviews total, no more.

• Paid 30-day trial at your full agreed monthly rate, with daily contact, mentorship and a weekly check-in. Written decision at day 30.

We hire off the test and the trial, not the interview. If you are the kind of strategist who would rather prove it than pitch it, apply.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sweetspot-heating-and-cooling-creative-strategist-ai-native-direct-response

About Pacaso

Pacaso exists to enrich lives by making second home ownership possible and enjoyable for more people. We've reimagined the second home category — pairing a thoughtfully designed co-ownership model with simplified financials, equitable scheduling, and dedicated local property management, so owners get the joy of a true second home without the hassle.

Since launch, Pacaso has facilitated more than $1.2 billion in gross real estate transactions and service fees across 40+ destinations in the U.S., Mexico, and Europe — including Aspen, Lake Tahoe, Napa, Malibu, Palm Springs, Cabo, Paris, London, and most recently Florence, Milan, and Rome. We've raised over $300 million in cumulative equity funding , closed the largest real estate Regulation A+ offering of 2025, and reserved the Nasdaq ticker PCSO as we build toward a public listing.

Our work has been featured in The New York Times , The Wall Street Journal , Fortune , Forbes , CNBC , Bloomberg , and others.

Recognition

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for both our culture and our category-defining work:

• No. 5, Forbes America's Best Startup Employers (2026) — our second consecutive Top 10 ranking

• Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2025)

• Winner, 2025 Inman Best of Proptech Awards — Consumer Experience & Marketplace Innovation

• Fortune & Great Place To Work Best Workplaces in Real Estate (2024)

• Best Workplace in the Bay Area™ (2023)

• LinkedIn Top Startup (2022) · Glassdoor Best Places to Work, #6 (2022)

The role

Pacaso buyers are high-net-worth individuals making a considered purchase over months, sometimes years. They move between our site, email, messaging, and our Sales team, and today each of those runs on its own tools with its own picture of the customer. We believe one personalized system that follows each customer from first interest to purchase, and keeps serving them as an owner, will shorten the path to purchase and make our growth product-led.

We're hiring a principal-level technical product IC to architect that system and own its outcome. You'll define the reference architecture: how we recognize a customer across channels, what we know about them, how the system decides what to do next, and which of those decisions AI agents can make without a person. You'll prove the design with working prototypes you build yourself with AI tooling, then lead Engineering and Data in taking it to production.

This isn't a roadmap-and-backlog PM role, and it isn't a full-time production engineering role. It sits between them. You'll make product calls with Sales, Marketing, and leadership, make architecture calls with senior engineers, and be accountable for both.

Some of this is already moving. AI agents talk to our customers today, and parts of the data and decisioning exist. None of it runs end to end on its own yet. You'll take what's there, decide what to keep, and design the system that can.

Company Description

WiseTech Global is a leading developer and provider of innovative software solutions for the logistics, global trade and supply chain industries worldwide. We serve more than 22,000 logistics companies across 193 countries, 23 of the 25 largest global freight forwarders worldwide. With the acquisition of e2open, we have expanded our network to encompass over 500,000 connected enterprises across manufacturing, logistics, channels and distribution. With the vision to be the operating system for global trade and logistics, we are creating a multi-sided marketplace connecting carriers, logistics providers, importers, exporters and shippers.

Job Description

A Pivotal Moment — Why Join E2open Now
In August 2025 WiseTech Global, developer of the world's leading logistics execution software CargoWise, completed its strategic acquisition of e2open. This acquisition represents one of the most significant strategic moves in global supply chain technology in recent years, and it creates an extraordinary moment to join this business.
WiseTech's CargoWise platform has historically focused on logistics service providers such as freight forwarders, carriers, and customs brokers. The e2open acquisition brings a deep, complementary product suite and customer base on the other side of the supply chain: the buyers, importers, exporters, shippers, manufacturers and brand owners who generate the freight in the first place.

The Opportunity
We are seeking an experienced and driven Area Sales Director to join our growing US sales organization. Each Area Sales Director owns a portfolio of approximately 20-30 enterprise accounts within our CPG business unit.
This role sits at the intersection of sales and professional services, with our most successful team members acting as strategic consultants and trusted advisors to our clients to help drive wider adoption of our existing product suite. This role covers the full spectrum of client engagement, from identifying opportunities and closing deals to staying involved throughout implementation to ensure successful delivery.
What You'll Do

• Build and grow a portfolio of enterprise accounts, driving cross-sell, upsell and new logo revenue.

• Develop trusted, senior-level relationships across your accounts through engaging stakeholders beyond the primary sponsor and maintaining a regular meeting cadence.

• Partner with Solutions Consulting, Legal, Professional Services and other internal teams to progress and close deals.

• Represent e2open at industry events to stay current on market trends and generate new business opportunities.

Salary: $100,000-$150,000 Base + Uncapped Commission

• 8–10+ years in supply chain and logistics, whether in consulting, operations, solution architecture, or enterprise B2B SaaS sales (exposure to S&OP, demand planning or inventory optimization in a CPG environment is highly preferred).

• Experience selling supply chain, logistics, ERP or adjacent enterprise software.

• Proven ability to close and manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals across long sales cycles.

• Confident presenting to C-suite and VP-level executives, with strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Consultative, value-based selling approach with genuine curiosity about customer challenges.

• Ability to articulate technical solutions clearly in business terms.

WiseTech Global is a leading developer and provider of innovative software solutions for the logistics, global trade and supply chain industries worldwide. In August 2025 WiseTech Global, developer of the world's leading logistics execution software CargoWise, completed its strategic acquisition of e2open. This role covers the full spectrum of client engagement, from identifying opportunities and closing deals to staying involved throughout implementation to ensure successful delivery.

• Confident presenting to C-suite and VP-level executives, with strong written and verbal communication skills.

At OnTheGoSystems, the company behind WPML , used on more than 1.5 million websites worldwide, we're looking for a creative, experienced Content Marketing Lead who knows how to turn great content into real business results.

AI has changed how we create content, and we embrace it. But great content still needs someone who understands customers, spots opportunities, tells compelling stories, and knows what actually works.

We're looking for someone who combines excellent writing skills, creativity, business understanding, and hands-on execution to make smart decisions, turn ideas into compelling content, attract customers, and help our business grow.

What You'll Do

You'll have the freedom to shape our content marketing, experiment with new ideas, and see the impact of your work.

•
Create content that makes a difference : write engaging website pages, articles, emails, and campaigns that attract and connect with customers.

•
Own the content direction : identify opportunities, set priorities, and bring ideas from concept to publication.

•
Make the most of AI : use AI tools to research, create, improve, and scale content while keeping quality high.

•
Grow our visibility : improve SEO and AI-search presence (GEO/AEO) to help more people discover our products.

•
Build connections : collaborate with partners, customers, and product experts to create content that stands out.

•
Turn insights into results : track performance, experiment, learn what works, and continuously improve.

You'll work closely with our CEO, product teams, and marketing colleagues, with plenty of room to bring your own ideas to life.

What We're Looking For

•
You're an excellent writer and experienced content marketer who can make even complex technical products interesting and easy to understand.

•
You've owned successful content marketing projects and can show the results of your work.

•
You are hands-on with SEO, email marketing, and content distribution , and know how they contribute to business growth.

•
You're AI-native, using AI tools confidently to create better content and work more effectively.

•
You understand customers, products, and competition , and can turn these insights into compelling content.

•
You're creative, proactive, and independent . You enjoy making decisions, trying new things, and taking responsibility for results.

•
You have experience with SaaS, software, WordPress, or other technical products .

Why Join Us?

We're a profitable, self-funded software company with a global customer base and a fully remote team.

You'll have the chance to own content marketing for an established product, work directly with decision-makers, experiment with the latest AI tools, and make a visible impact on our business.

We value great ideas, initiative, and people who enjoy turning opportunities into results.

What We Offer

•
100% remote work with an international team.

•
Paid time off and national holidays to recharge.

•
Body and Mind Movement (BAMM) program to support your hobbies and well-being.

•
Computer budget for a comfortable workspace.

•
Kindle and access to our company Amazon account.

•
Smart, supportive, and self-driven colleagues from around the world.

•
Freedom to experiment, grow, and make a real impact.

Love creating content, exploring what AI can do, and seeing your ideas turn into real results? We'd love to meet you!

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/onthegosystems-content-marketing-lead

• Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage editing many projects at once.

• Flexible and able to adapt to a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

• Able to conduct themselves in a professional, remote-first environment.

Ideal candidate profile:

• Bachelor’s degree in film studies, cinematography, or related field (not mandatory).

• Previous work experience as a video editor.

• Hands-on experience with editing software, including Adobe After Effects, Final Cut Pro X, Avid Media Composer, Lightworks, and Premier.

• Creative and artistic skills.

• Familiarity with 3D composition and special effects.

• Portfolio of completed film productions.

• Ability to work to a tight schedule.

• Ability to translate ideas into complete projects.

Compensation:
The compensation range is $800-$1,800 USD a month (based on the experience).
Location:
All of our team is working completely remotely. Yes, that’s right! Work remotely from wherever you want! We’ll make sure your working experience is as comfortable as possible!

About the Role:

We're looking for a Mid-Market Solutions Consultant based in Europe to help expand our presence in the German markets.
In the role, you'll work with our growing Mid-Market team to engage with small to mid-sized property managers and support them through their initial discovery of PriceLabs to becoming active users.

The role operates during CET hours (9:30 AM to 6:30 PM CET / 1 PM to 10:00 PM Indian Standard Time), focusing primarily on converting smaller to mid-sized inbound prospects.

This role is available to individuals residing in Germany, Austria, Spain or Portugal who hold a valid work permit.

Compensation: €30,000 – €40,000 per year (total compensation, including base salary and variable pay), depending on experience and location.

Key responsibilities:

• Serving as the primary point of contact for new small to mid-sized property managers throughout their onboarding process

• Driving conversions of new prospects by conducting compelling and detailed virtual product demonstrations

• Assist new prospects in setting up their PriceLabs accounts and optimize their PriceLabs usage as per their unique revenue management strategies and preferences.

• Clearly and effectively communicating PriceLabs’ value proposition to potential clients

• Consistently meeting & exceeding performance expectations

• Collaborate with the Sales ops team to update and maintain key information and history associated with onboarded mid-size accounts on the CRM

• Facilitate knowledge transfer and smooth handover of selective onboarded accounts that grow beyond mid-size by collaborating with the sales-ops team and In-market Solution Consultants to ensure dedicated account management

About You:

• Proven experience (2-3+ years) as an Account Executive, in Customer Success, or in other sales/customer-facing roles, preferably in a SaaS company

• Fluent in German and English (verbal and written)

• Adept at conducting product walk-throughs over video calls and effectively communicating a product’s value and ROI to clients

• A track record of achieving defined sales performance metrics

• Data-driven, analytical, and quantitative mindset

• Excellent communication/presentation skills and ability to build relationships

• Exceptionally well-organized and good with time-management skills

• Experience with the short-term rental market and managing US/European clients is a plus

How to apply for this position?

Please fill out the form with the required details. If your profile is shortlisted, our team will reach out to you via email. If you don't find the emails in your inbox, please check your spam folder.
Tip: Avoid using AI-generated responses. We want to hear from you!

About PriceLabs:

PriceLabs is a revenue management solution for the short-term rental and hospitality industry, founded in 2014 and headquartered in Chicago, IL. Our platform helps individual hosts and hospitality professionals optimize their pricing and revenue management, adapting to changing market trends and occupancy levels.

With dynamic pricing, automation rules, and customizations, we manage pricing and minimum-stay restrictions for any portfolio size, with prices automatically uploaded to preferred channels.
Every day, we price over 700,000+ listings globally across 150+ countries, offering world-class tools like the Base Price Help and Minimum Stay Recommendation Engine.

In 2026, we scaled to;

• 700K+ listings

• 160+ integrations

• 150+ countries

• 300+ globally remote team

• 80K+ customers worldwide

• 40% diversity

Industry awards won:

• SaasBoomi 2021

• The Shortyz 2020

• The Shortyz 2023

• STRive Awards 2025

• STRive Awards 2026

We continue to grow exponentially, backed by a strong team to take us to the next level.

Why join PriceLabs?

• We are a remote-first organization and accept work from home as the norm.

• Work with an industry-leading product that has thousands of customers worldwide, and our customers love the product! (NPS in the 70s, Customer reviews here)

• Work with a global team (19 countries and counting) of passionate individuals who accept open communication, empowerment, and a shared focus on customer success.

PriceLabs is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal opportunity in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, age, veteran status, marital status or physical challenges.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: Nashville, Tennessee, United States

URL: https://kimbrellagency.na.teamtailor.com

Kimbrell Agency

Remote (Nashville, TN area)
Employment Type: Contractor
Compensation $50,000 to $100,000 per year (plus commission)
If you're reading this and thinking, "Insurance? Really?" I get it. I've thought that too—and I still do. The truth is, I'm not passionate about insurance. I'm passionate about people. We don’t just build careers; we build people who, in turn, build businesses. The result? Success and fulfillment.
We look forward to discovering what success means to you and, if we find that this is the right fit, we are fully committed to providing you with the tools, training, and support to make it happen.
The Problem with Most Insurance Jobs:
Let’s be real—most agencies are desperate to hire anyone with a pulse, offer minimal support, and if you're lucky, they might invest in you six months down the line. We think that's unacceptable.
At The Kimbrell Agency, we do things differently. We invest heavily from the start to ensure you're the right fit for this career. That means we pour everything into your long-term success. No leader can give everything it takes to help an agent succeed when they’re bringing on anyone who applies. Unfortunately, most agencies make empty promises: "Be in business for yourself, but not by yourself," or "We offer hands-on support and training."
Here, we actually mean it. And we have a proven track record of success to back it up.

What We Offer:
A Proven Lead System: Say goodbye to cold calling. Our streamlined lead generation system puts you in front of qualified buyers who have requested coverage. You’ll call these clients, set appointments, and meet virtually to help them find the best insurance plan for their needs and budget. Some agents even start part-time and transition to full-time.
A Real Opportunity for Growth: This role is perfect for self-disciplined sales professionals who are ready to put in the work. If you need someone looking over your shoulder or a time clock to punch, this isn't the right fit. But if you're driven, gritty and ready to build something meaningful, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities:
Present and sell insurance products to new and existing customers.
Reach out to potential clients who have requested coverage.
Handle customer inquiries and resolve complaints.
Participate in regular Zoom training sessions.

Who We're Looking For:
Previous experience in sales, customer service, or a related field is a plus.
Familiarity with CRM platforms is helpful.
You know how to build rapport and trust with clients.
You’re deadline-driven, detail-oriented, and dedicated to delivering results.
Integrity and a strong work ethic are a must.
We’re seeking individuals who are ambitious, coachable, passionate about helping others, and driven to achieve greatness. If you’re ready to take control of your future and create a career you can be proud of, we’d love to connect.

Why Choose Us?
True Agency Ownership: Here, you’ll have the chance to own your business—contractually protect what you build.
Game-Changing Lead Program: We provide the industry’s best leads, generated in-house and heavily subsidized to help you succeed.
Comprehensive Training & Support: From day one, we offer hands-on training, including daily coaching calls, weekly one-on-ones, and group sessions. You’ll have a system to follow at every step of the way.
Industry-Leading Compensation: Our compensation plan is designed to deliver real profit, with vested rights from day one.
Dedicated Conservation Team: Our team ensures your business stays protected from chargebacks, giving you one of the highest persistency rates in the industry.
World-Class Travel & Incentives: Have the ability to earn 3-4 fully-paid trips per year, all expenses covered.
Unlimited Earning Potential: This is a commission and bonus-based position, with no cap on how much you can earn. Your income potential is truly unlimited.

A Few More Details:
This role does require a Life and Health Insurance License, but don’t worry—we’ll help you obtain it through a streamlined online course that takes just 7-10 days.
Please note: Success in this role varies. Your level of success will depend on several factors, including the effort you put in, your ability to follow and implement our proven system, and the specific insurance needs in your geographic area. Not all agents achieve the same results, and earnings are based on individual performance.
Ready to Build Your Future with Us?
If you're ready to make a difference—not just in your own life, but in the lives of others—apply today. We can’t wait to see how you define success.

jobs.sourceName: RSS: We Work Remotely: Sales and Marketing
jobs.description:
Headquarters: United States

URL: http://www.pritchardindustries.com

Pritchard Industries is a dynamic and innovative provider of comprehensive facility services, dedicated to enhancing the operational efficiency of our client partners in the industries we serve. With services from facility maintenance and janitorial to landscaping and snow removal, we enable desired outcomes for our clients through consistent service and outstanding people.

We are seeking an initiative-taking and experienced Proposal Writer. As the Proposal Writer, you will play a crucial role in crafting compelling proposals that highlight our company's capabilities and expertise to potential clients. Your ability to synthesize complex information, tailor content, and communicate value propositions effectively will directly contribute to our success in securing new business opportunities.

This is a 100% remote role but must reside in the central or eastern time zones.

Responsibilities:

Proposal Development:

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales, marketing, subject matter experts, and management, to gather necessary information for proposal content.

• Translate technical and business information into clear, persuasive, and client-focused language.

• Minimum 3 years proposal writing experience

Content Creation:

• Write and edit proposal content, including executive summaries, project descriptions, methodologies, timelines, budgets, and other relevant sections.

• Ensure that proposals are tailored to the specific needs and requirements of each client or project.

Strategic Messaging:

• Develop a deep understanding of client pain points, objectives, and industry trends to craft persuasive value propositions.

• Tailor messaging to highlight the unique benefits our company offers to address client challenges.

Formatting and Design:

• Create visually appealing and well-organized proposal documents that are consistent with company branding guidelines.

• Use graphics, charts, and visuals to enhance the presentation of complex information.

Quality Assurance:

• Review and proofread proposal content to ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency.

• Verify compliance with RFP (Request for Proposal) guidelines and requirements.

Research and Analysis:

• Conduct research to gather relevant data, statistics, case studies, and market insights to support proposal arguments.

• Analyze client needs and competition to formulate effective proposal strategies.

Deadline Management:

• Prioritize and manage multiple proposal projects simultaneously, adhering to tight deadlines.

• Coordinate with team members to ensure timely completion of all proposal components.

Knowledge Management:

• Maintain a repository of proposal content, templates, case studies, and references for future use.

• Continuously update and refine content based on feedback and industry changes.

Collaboration and Communication:

• Foster open communication with internal stakeholders to gather accurate and up-to-date information.

• Participate in meetings and discussions to understand project requirements and client expectations.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in English, Communications, Marketing, Business, or a related field.

• Proven experience as a Proposal Writer or in a similar role.

• Experience with facility services industry.

• Strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills.

• Excellent attention to detail and ability to synthesize complex information.

• Familiarity with proposal formatting and design best practices.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

• Ability to work well under pressure and meet strict deadlines.

• Strong organizational and project management skills.

• Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

• Familiarity with proposal software or tools is a plus.

Benefits

• Salary range: $65,000 - $85,000 based on experience.

• 100% Remote in the Central or Eastern Time Zones only.

• Paid holidays and vacation time

• Health Benefits Package

• Ancillary benefits—Life insurance, Long Term Disability, FSA, and Dependent Spending care

• 401K

• Opportunity for growth

Pritchard Industries participates in E-Verify.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/pritchard-industries-proposal-writer

jobs.description:
Headquarters: Hungary - Budapest

URL: http://veeva.com

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry , committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Are you looking for a place where your work makes an impact? We are seeking a talented Cloud CRM Consultant to join our amazing, fast-paced team of experts in Hungary.

The Senior Cloud CRM Consultant is a member of our Commercial Managed Services team who provides ongoing professional service for customers live with Veeva’s commercial solutions.

You will provide application consulting and serve as the strategic bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring systems are scalable, secure, and built to drive business value primarily on the Vault CRM application, but will potentially develop expertise across other Commercial products. You will identify customer requirements, perform configuration changes to the system, activate new product features and act as an advising partner.

This is a remote, full-time role with Veeva. Candidates must be legally authorised to be employed in Europe. jobs.description:

URL: http://bondora.group

At Bondora, our mission is simple: to make finance easy, transparent, and accessible for everyone.

Founded in 2008, we’ve helped more than 700,000 customers across Europe borrow and invest effortlessly through our trusted digital products.

As a rapidly growing financial technology company, we’re reaching new heights with a bold vision. We’re set to acquire a banking license, unlocking a world of possibilities for our customers. This transition will allow us to expand our lending across more EU countries and broaden our product suite to deliver even more value.

Join us on this journey and let’s build the future of finance together!

What is this role about? 🚀

As a CRM Manager , you build and run the customer journeys that guide Bondora’s customers through their whole lifecycle: from their first loan application and onboarding, to repeat loans and add-ons, to the moments when repayments get difficult. You’ll be one of three CRM Managers in Bondora’s CRM & Customer Value team, reporting to the Head of CRM & Customer Value. Our CRM runs on Braze, with unusually rich customer and loan data and value signals already flowing in. You’ll decide what to build by its value in loans and euros, prove what works against holdout groups, and treat every customer fairly: a loan is a financial decision, not a shopping cart.

Your main responsibilities 🎯

• Build and run customer journeys in Braze across the lifecycle: application and onboarding, repeat loans and add-ons, reactivation, and payment difficulty, with QA before every launch and zero customer-facing errors.

• Design journeys around the customer’s situation: triggers, timing, cadence, channels and fallback, stop rules, and handovers to self-service, a human or another journey.

• Prove what works: build a control or holdout into every journey and report results as business outcomes (signed loans, revenue, arrears), not opens or clicks.

• Prioritise by value: size opportunities in loans and euros before building, and rank your work by value rather than volume.

• Own compliance and risk suppression: classify messages correctly, respect consent, never send commercial messages to customers showing payment risk, and involve Legal and Risk before launch.

• Keep the data reliable: validate events and attributes, fix journeys that act on wrong or late data, and escalate upstream issues with evidence.

• Move legacy communications into Braze and work through the team’s shared rules: one intake route for requests, and clean handovers with the other CRM Managers.

What would ensure success in this role?💪

• 5+ years of hands-on experience in CRM or lifecycle marketing. Experience in lending, fintech or recurring-revenue businesses is a plus.

• Hands-on production experience in Braze or a comparable platform (Iterable, Customer.io, Salesforce Marketing Cloud): journeys, segmentation, event and API triggers, dynamic content and QA. You build it yourself, not through an agency.

• Experience designing journeys for different lifecycle stages, built around the customer’s situation rather than a fixed sequence.

• Experimentation literacy: you design tests with holdouts, read business outcomes rather than open rates, and can pull your own data (SQL or a product analytics tool).

• Commercial judgment: you can estimate what an improvement is worth in loans and euros and decide what to build first.

Headquarters: Armenia Yerevan, EMEA, Armenia

URL: http://replika.com

About Replika
In 2017, no one knew what AI was supposed to be. We built the world's first consumer AI app. Two million people showed up in two months. Today it's over 40 million, and the thing they keep telling us hasn't changed: it helped. It made their life better, steadier, a little less alone.
Most AI is built for tasks, not for people. It gives you answers, but it doesn't care what you do with them. AI doesn't just need intelligence. It needs intention. Because the real question isn't just what AI can do. It's what AI is for.
When the world's leading researchers wanted to understand whether AI could actually change someone's life, they studied Replika, because there was nothing else to study. What they found at Stanford, at Harvard, across years of research, was that Replika doesn't replace human connection. It deepens it. People become more social, more confident, more themselves. Not in theory. In their actual lives.
Every major AI company talks about their mission for humanity. None of them has ever clearly said what they're trying to do for a single person. We will. We want to help you flourish in real life. Not become a better version of yourself, just more yourself. Strong relationships. Better health. Meaning. Momentum. A life that feels worth living while you're living it.
We're building the kind of AI that follows up. That knows the people in your life and nudges you to reach out when it matters. That sends you a poem, just because. The goal is conversations that lead somewhere real. Maybe it's a text you send to a long lost friend. A hobby you pick up again. A moment you show up for yourself.
Everyone else is building AI that thinks. We're building AI that cares.
Lifecycle & CRM Specialist
About this role
Millions of people have already met Replika: free users who haven't upgraded yet, subscribers who've lapsed, and people who signed up years ago and drifted away. Almost none of them hear from us in a way that's worth opening. That's the biggest untapped channel we have, and you'll own it.
You'll build our lifecycle program from the ground up. Email first, then in-app messages, push and any other channel that gets the right message to the right person at the right moment. Onboarding, free-to-paid conversion, renewals, win-back, product launches. The goal is revenue and retention, not open rates.
This is a hands-on role. You'll help set the lifecycle strategy and build it yourself: the segments, the flows, the copy, the tests and the reporting.
Our users are in almost every country, so you'll work within consent and privacy rules for a global audience, and you'll know how to design a program that is both compliant and effective.
What You’ll Be Doing

• Build the core lifecycle flows: onboarding, free-to-paid conversion, intro offers ending, renewals, cancellation saves and win-back.

• Convert free users. Work with product on in-app messages and offers that move people to paid at the right moment.

• Reactivate our base. Plan and run campaigns to lapsed users and our long-dormant email list, cleanly and within consent.

• Segment and personalize with product and subscription data, so each person gets the message that fits where they are.

• Test everything: timing, subject lines, offers, channels. Keep what wins and kill what doesn't.

• Own deliverability, list health and the reporting that ties every flow to revenue.

What We’re Looking For

• Hands-on lifecycle or CRM experience at a consumer subscription app, with revenue results you can show.

• You've built flows yourself in a modern messaging platform like Braze, Customer.io, Iterable or Klaviyo.

• Strong with data. You build your own segments and read your own results without waiting for an analyst.

• You understand compliant communication for a global audience: consent, unsubscribes, GDPR, CAN-SPAM and their equivalents.

• You write good copy, or know exactly how to brief and edit it.

• You shape the strategy and do the implementation yourself.

• Excellent written English.

Bonus Points

• In-app messaging and push experience on iOS and Android.

• Deliverability experience: domain reputation, warming, and bringing a large dormant list back safely.

• Experience with web and app subscription billing and the events it sends.

• You've worked on a product where trust and tone really matter.

What You’ll Get

• Flexible job schedule and generous vacation policy.

• Direct impact on millions of worldwide users within months.

• Push the boundaries of applied AI in a consumer setting.

• Fully remote, able to work CET hours.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - PlanetScale Postgres
jobs.sourceName: RSS: We Work Remotely: Programming
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote

PlanetScale is growing rapidly and reinventing the database space. The PlanetScale platform delivers a fully managed, multi-cloud Postgres service designed for the most demanding production workloads. We handle the complexity of provisioning, scaling, replication, and failover - so engineering teams can focus on building their products.

Our customers entrust us with their most precious digital asset, their data, so the stakes couldn't be higher. We're looking for a Software Engineer to join our Postgres engineering team and help us build a world-class managed Postgres offering.

What's the job to be done?

• You will design and build the control plane that provisions, scales, and heals Postgres clusters with minimal customer-visible downtime.

• You will build and maintain high availability, disaster recovery, and data protection solutions that keep customer databases safe through infrastructure failures.

• You will tune Postgres to operate at scale for some of the largest and most demanding workloads in the world.

• You will build tooling and automation for database operations, backup, restore, and migration workflows - and participate in an on-call rotation.

• You will work directly with customers to understand their workloads and translate real-world needs into platform improvements.

These attributes best describe you…

• You have strong experience building, operating, or maintaining large-scale Postgres deployments in production.

• You have an excellent understanding of low-level operating systems concepts including multi-threading, memory management, networking, storage, and performance.

• You have strong fundamental computer science skills and can reason about distributed, fault-tolerant systems.

• You thrive in a collaborative environment, enjoy mentoring other engineers, and communicate complex technical tradeoffs clearly.

• You are self-motivated and can work independently with minimal guidance while making sound technical decisions.

What you will need

• 5+ years of software engineering experience designing, building, and supporting large-scale systems in production.

• Strong proficiency in Go, with experience in other languages like Ruby, Python, Zig or Rust.

• Experience building and maintaining distributed, fault-tolerant services.

• Working knowledge of Kubernetes and containerized applications.

• Experience building and operating distributed systems at scale.

What else will help you be successful

• Experience building or operating a database-as-a-service or managed database platform.

• Experience with connection pooling and proxy layers for Postgres.

• Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and infrastructure-as-code.

• Contributions to open-source projects, especially in the Postgres or database infrastructure space.

• Experience working with remote, geographically distributed teams.

• Previous experience at a high-growth technology company.

Why PlanetScale

We're redefining how high-growth companies manage data at scale—and we work with some of the most exciting brands in gaming, consumer tech, and B2B SaaS. As a Software Engineer, you'll be at the core of building the platform that powers world-class apps used by hundreds of millions of users worldwide. PlanetScale is a profitable company with a philosophy centered around building small teams of p99 individuals and is recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in America.

At PlanetScale we believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive no matter the location. Our mission is to build a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company. We strive to build an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued, whether they are a candidate or an employee. We welcome applicants of any educational background, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, citizenship, socioeconomic status, disability, pregnancy status, and veteran status.

If you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

Total Compensation and Pay Transparency

An employee's total compensation consists of base salary + variable comp where appropriate + benefits + equity. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be happy to answer any further questions when we engage with you to begin the interview process.

Base salary range: $120,000 - $290,000 USD

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/planetscale-software-engineer-planetscale-postgres
